title: Version 3.1.4 Changelog
items: Install and update the desktop app without the setup wizard
Only download and run https .exe or .msi updates
Validate IPC senders and match navigation origin exactly
Harden Google sign-in and password login
Limit failed logins per IP and per account
Enforce a strict script CSP and escape the viewer page
Keep share links from exposing trashed or foreign files
Require Download permission to open documents
Let OnlyOffice save while desktop-only access is on
Show every item of large folders on the Cloud Drive
Lock Cloud Drive creates per path instead of globally
Fix bridge line framing and speed up clipboard copies
Keep folder ZIP downloads from hanging or starving the DB pool
Make migrations atomic and drain requests on shutdown
Stop transfer progress from re-rendering the whole app
Share one Redis subscriber across all SSE streams
Speed up password hashing, auth lookups, and encryption streams
Name the field in validation errors and show the reason
Match % and _ literally in file search
